{{Quote|Tell Fleet I still think they are heading for Atrivis to smear the army on Mantooine. If they are following standard operating procedures, they'll be moving tomorrow. If Ackbar moves fast and gets to Mantooine first, he can pop 'em as they come out of hyperspace.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zgorth'sth]]|<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ambushed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] in a '''battle''' in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]]. The Oplovis Fleet was task force that was en route to the [[Mantooine system/Legends|Mantooine system]] to attack the Rebel presence in the system. [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] operative [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zgorth'sth]] surmised the attack plan by analyzing Imperial requisition records. Alerting Alliance [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]] [[Vernan (general)|Vernan]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and three Alliance cruisers then ambushed the Imperial ships as they emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], resulting in a convincing victory for the Alliance.<ref name="RAS1" />
